title: creating delights
description: Create and farmers delight based modpack
body:
A multiplayer-focused modpack built around Create and related tech/decoration mods, plus performance and QoL improvements. Designed for cooperative basebuilding, automation, exploration, and creativity while keeping performance smooth for mid-range systems. Expect a stable play experience with two known incompatible mods (being investigated) — otherwise ready for friends and server (with some tweaks).

Highlights

Deep Create ecosystem: Create and 40+ Create addons and integrations for machines, trains, new content, decoration, and factory gameplay.

Performance & rendering: Sodium + Lithium + FerriteCore + Sodium extras and compatibility layers for smoother FPS.

QoL & UX: JEI, AppleSkin, Cloth Config/YACL, Curios, Sophisticated Backpacks, Carry On, Freecam, video/options improvements.

Food & biomes: Farmer’s Delight and multiple “Delight” expansions, Veggies Delight, My Nether’s Delight, Underground Village, Stoneholm.

Tools, utilities & mapping: WorldEdit, Xaero’s minimaps/world map, Controlify (controller support), More Delight content mods.

Visual & playback additions: 
Create: Sound of Steam and tuning wrench, shader support hooks, sodium dynamic lights.
Inventory, crafting & 

resource helpers: JER, Resourceful Lib, Chipped, Chipped Express (decorative storage/blocks).
